rows: Engineers who want the fastest single exam to reach a strong-paying, stable technical role at a large public sector company.
One step score opens many PSU doors, but branch-wise cutoffs are steep for Mechanical, Electrical, and Civil, and each PSU runs its own separate shortlisting window.
Diploma or degree engineers who want a faster central government entry without a step-level fight.
No step score, no interview, two objective papers. Pay is modest next to a PSU or ESE offer, but the odds are meaningfully better.
Engineers who want railway-specific technical roles, job security, and perks like a free travel pass and quarters.
JE accepts diploma holders; SSE is degree-only and pays noticeably more, but its second stage is genuinely harder.
